description: This source file defines the MessagingIntentService class which extends Android's IntentService to handle messaging reply actions in a wearable notification context. It processes reply intents, updates messaging notifications with new messages, and rebuilds notifications with messaging styles, handling both remote input and notification updates.

classes.name: MessagingIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles messaging reply actions from notifications, updates messaging style notifications with new messages, and rebuilds notifications in case of process death.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Overrides the IntentService method to handle incoming intents, particularly reply actions.

methods.name: handleActionReply
methods.description: Processes a reply from the user, updates the messaging notification with the new message, and requests the notification to be updated.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Extracts the reply message CharSequence from an intent with remote input results.

methods.name: recreateBuilderWithMessagingStyle
methods.description: Recreates and returns a NotificationCompat.Builder configured with the current messaging style, including participants and conversation history.
